description: Test suite for shared channel membership synchronization in Mattermost, including setup and various membership add/remove scenarios with remote cluster considerations.

methods.name: setupMembershipTest
methods.description: Creates test fixtures including mock server, app, stores, and enables membership sync feature flag.

methods.name: TestOnReceiveMembershipChanges_ChannelIdMismatch
methods.description: Tests handling of membership change messages with mismatched channel IDs.

methods.name: TestProcessMemberAdd_RejectsLocalUser
methods.description: Verifies that adding a local user (without remote ID) is rejected.

methods.name: TestProcessMemberAdd_RejectsOtherRemoteUser
methods.description: Verifies that adding a user from a different remote cluster is rejected.

methods.name: TestProcessMemberAdd_AllowsOwnRemoteUser
methods.description: Checks that adding a user from the same remote cluster proceeds successfully.

methods.name: TestProcessMemberRemove_RejectsLocalUser
methods.description: Verifies that removing a local user (without remote ID) is rejected.

methods.name: TestProcessMemberRemove_RejectsOtherRemoteUser
methods.description: Verifies that removing a user from a different remote cluster is rejected.

methods.name: TestProcessMemberRemove_AllowsOwnRemoteUser
methods.description: Checks that removing a user from the same remote cluster proceeds successfully.

methods.name: TestProcessMemberAdd_RejectsLocalUser_ErrorMessage
methods.description: Ensures error message is returned when adding a local user.

methods.name: TestProcessMemberRemove_RejectsLocalUser_ErrorMessage
methods.description: Ensures error message is returned when removing a local user.
